source: Bing GetPageQueryStats (weekly rows summed, Bing's full returned range) + stage 03b GSC 90d + 03c + leads

thresholds._doc: A page is protected if ANY test passes. Leverage = bing_clicks >= leverage_bing_clicks AND (google not indexed OR gsc_impr_90d < leverage_gsc_impr_below). Protect-list query inclusion: any bing click, bing_impr >= list_bing_impr, any gsc click, or gsc_impr >= list_gsc_impr. A query counts as answered when best section token-overlap score >= answer_min.
